mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Elise has stored Spiderlings that will join her when she enters Spider Form.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Lunge at an enemy, dealing more damage as their Health falls.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: <keywordMajor>Spider Form</keywordMajor>: Lunge at an enemy, dealing <magicDamage>@spell.Jade_EliseSpiderQ:BaseDamage@ plus @spell.Jade_EliseSpiderQ:MissingHPDamage@ of the target's missing Health as magic damage</magicDamage>. The Health-based damage is capped at <scaleBonus>@spell.Jade_EliseSpiderQ:DamageCap@</scaleBonus> against monsters.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtended:
Spider Form: Lunge at an enemy, dealing @spell.Jade_EliseSpiderQ:BaseDamage@ plus @spell.Jade_EliseSpiderQ:MissingHPDamage@ of the target's missing Health as magic damage. The Health-based damage is capped at @spell.Jade_EliseSpiderQ:DamageCap@ against monsters.

Human Form: Spit neurotoxin, dealing @spell.Jade_EliseQ:BaseDamage@ plus @spell.Jade_EliseQ:HumanPercentHealth@ of the target's current Health as magic damage. The Health-based damage is capped at @spell.Jade_EliseQ:DamageCap@ against monsters.

mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Human Form ability hits store Spiderlings. In Spider Form, Elise deals bonus magic damage on attack and her Spiderlings fight beside her.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Human Form: Ability hits store dormant Spiderlings. Spider Form: Attacks deal bonus magic damage and your Spiderlings attack alongside you.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Human Form: Ability hits grant dormant Spiderlings, up to @spell.Jade_EliseR:BaseSpiderlingsStored@.

Spider Form: Attacks deal @spell.Jade_EliseR:PassiveTotalDamage@ bonus magic damage and your Spiderlings attack nearby enemies for @spell.Jade_EliseR:SpiderlingTotalDamage@ physical damage each.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine: <rules><keywordMajor>Spiderlings</keywordMajor> have <scaleHealth>@spell.Jade_EliseR:SpiderlingTotalHealthTooltip@ Health</scaleHealth>, <scaleArmor>@spell.Jade_EliseR:SpiderlingArmor@ Armor</scaleArmor>, <scaleMR>@spell.Jade_EliseR:SpiderlingMagicResist@ Magic Resist </scaleMR>, and receive only 75% area of effect damage.</rules>

mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Elise is in Spider Form. Her attacks deal bonus magic damage, and her Spiderlings attack nearby enemies.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Return to Human Form and store your Spiderlings for your next transformation.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Return to <keywordMajor>Human Form</keywordMajor>. Your <keywordMajor>Spiderlings</keywordMajor> become dormant.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtended:
Return to Human Form. Your Spiderlings become dormant.

Transform into Spider Form, becoming melee, dealing @spell.Jade_EliseR:PassiveTotalDamage@ bonus magic damage on-hit, and summoning your dormant Spiderlings who attack for @spell.Jade_EliseR:SpiderlingTotalDamage@ physical damage each.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Spiderlings gain passive Attack Speed. Activate to increase Elise and her Spiderlings' Attack Speed and heal Elise when they attack.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Spider Form Passive: Spiderlings gain @spell.Jade_EliseSpiderW:PassiveAttackSpeed*100@% Attack Speed.

Active: Grant yourself and your Spiderlings @spell.Jade_EliseSpiderW:AttackSpeedBonusPercent*100@% Attack Speed for @spell.Jade_EliseSpiderW:SpiderWDuration@ seconds. During the frenzy, your attacks and your Spiderlings' attacks restore @spell.Jade_EliseSpiderW:TotalHealing@ Health to you.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtended:
Spider Form Passive: Spiderlings gain @spell.Jade_EliseSpiderW:PassiveAttackSpeed*100@% Attack Speed.

Active: Grant yourself and your Spiderlings @spell.Jade_EliseSpiderW:AttackSpeedBonusPercent*100@% Attack Speed for @spell.Jade_EliseSpiderW:SpiderWDuration@ seconds. During the frenzy, your attacks and your Spiderlings' attacks restore @spell.Jade_EliseSpiderW:TotalHealing@ Health to you.

Human Form: Summon an explosive Spiderling that chases nearby enemies that explodes on contact or after @spell.Jade_EliseW:TimeToExplode@ seconds to deal @spell.Jade_EliseW:TotalDamage@ magic damage.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Ascend with your Spiderlings, becoming untargetable, then descend upon an enemy.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: <keywordMajor>Spider Form</keywordMajor>: Ascend with your <keywordMajor>Spiderlings</keywordMajor>, becoming Untargetable and revealing nearby enemies. <recast>Recast</recast> on an enemy to descend to them.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtended:
Spider Form: Ascend with your Spiderlings, becoming Untargetable and revealing nearby enemies. Recast on an enemy to descend to them.

Human Form: Fire a cocoon that Stuns for @spell.Jade_EliseE:HumanEDuration@ seconds and Reveals the target.

mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Elise and her Spiderlings gain Attack Speed. Their attacks restore Health to Elise.
This unit is stunned by Cocoon.
Elise is untargetable above the battlefield and can descend upon a nearby enemy.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Fire a cocoon that stuns the first enemy hit and reveals them if they are visible.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: <keywordMajor>Human Form</keywordMajor>: Fire a cocoon that <status>Stuns</status> for @spell.Jade_EliseE:HumanEDuration@ seconds and <status>Reveals</status> the target.

Human Form: Fire a cocoon that Stuns for @spell.Jade_EliseE:HumanEDuration@ seconds and Reveals the target.

Spider Form: Ascend with your Spiderlings, becoming Untargetable and revealing nearby enemies. Recast on an enemy to descend to them.
